_comment: Canonical daemon-owned alpha recall envelope (issues #817/#818, parent #789). The daemon nests this at `ToolResponse.result.alpha_recall` on `preflight.run`. The `bicameral-mcp` thin client renders `product.staged`, `product.caveats`, `witness.topology_receipt`, and `witness.runtime_trace` verbatim; it must not compute recall, own freshness, derive caveats, or widen authority. The daemon preserves the sibling result keys `staged` and `live_recall` for back-compat, but `alpha_recall` is the canonical envelope.
